Question: Aslam o alaikum, can u interpret my dream.In dream i was walking and i saw wolves coming towards me and passing me.thn i saw human man comin but they changed to wolves.in the dream i also ran to them to scare thm but i failed.please can u tel me what does this dream mean? Answer ID: 8498 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1352/198=TL/1429) This is a satanic dream . Recite ayatul kursi and the four Quls ( سورۃ الکافرون، الاخلاص، الفلق، الناس ), blow on your hand and pass over your body before going to bed. In-sha-Allah, you shall be protected against such dreams. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
